items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: And, well, they were recording again, recording records. And you jump right into records with Duke. And we played there, and played there quite a while. You heard of Sonny Grier, he was on drums... And Sonny, the guitar player. And Braut on bass, of course, Duke on the piano. And we just had -- that

ctx.x: I didn't have the chance to feel any remorse or anything, because I went right out of the pan into the fire, so to speak. I went with him like that, the next night in the Kentucky Club. He only had one trumpet, Bubba Marley. And he had about eight pieces there, with me.
